s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually developing skin lesion with verrucous appearance and papules
salient_findings: Slightly reddish verrucous plaque on the right temple
Translucent papules and plaques with surface hemorrhagic crust
Papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia and neoplastic infiltration of small round blue cells
key_facts: Asymptomatic skin lesion on the right temple
Lesion gradually developed over 8 months
No associated fevers, weight loss, or night sweats
Lesion is nontender with no purulent discharge
No hepatosplenomegaly or superficial lymphadenopathy
Laboratory tests showed no abnormalities
Imaging studies revealed skin thickening and a soft-tissue mass in the right frontotemporal region
Histopathology showed papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia and neoplastic infiltration
Tumor cells are positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin

shortlist.why_kept: Positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin, consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Verrucous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Verrucous appearance and papules, consistent with verrucous carcinoma

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Gradually developing skin lesion with papules, consistent with dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans

shortlist.label: Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Neoplastic infiltration with small round blue cells, consistent with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma

raw.rationale: The tumor cells are positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin, which are markers for rhabdomyosarcoma, and the histopathology shows papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia and neoplastic infiltration consistent with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma

rejected.label: Verrucous carcinoma
rejected.why: While the lesion has a verrucous appearance, the immunohistochemistry results do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: The histopathology and immunohistochemistry results do not match this diagnosis

rejected.label: Rhabdomyosarcoma
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, but the specific subtype is more accurate

rejected.label: Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The histopathology does not show the characteristic alveolar pattern of this subtype
